description: Angular component for configuring a basic bar chart widget in the Thingsboard platform, including default data keys, settings, and template references.

classes.name: BarChartBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending LatestChartBasicConfigComponent to provide configuration for a bar chart widget, including default data keys, settings, and template handling.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys for wind, solar, and hydroelectric power with specific colors.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default bar chart widget settings.

methods.name: latestChartConfigTemplate
methods.description: Returns the template reference for the bar chart configuration.

methods.name: setupLatestChartControls
methods.description: Sets up form controls for bar chart settings such as axis min/max and label styles.

methods.name: prepareOutputLatestChartConfig
methods.description: Prepares and assigns the chart configuration output based on form data.
